```python
import os
import re
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Generator, List, Optional

from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Response, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

TAG_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9]{1,30}$")

app = FastAPI(title="Notes Service")


class NoteCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str
    body: str = ""
    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class NoteOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    body: str
    created_at: str
    tags: List[str]


def get_db_path() -> str:
    return os.getenv("NOTES_DB", "notes.db")


def utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def init_db() -> None:
    schema_path = Path(__file__).with_name("schema.sql")
    schema_sql = schema_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    conn = sqlite3.connect(get_db_path())
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
        conn.executescript(schema_sql)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.on_event("startup")
def startup_event() -> None:
    init_db()


def get_conn() -> Generator[sqlite3.Connection, None, None]:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(get_db_path())
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    try:
        yield conn
    finally:
        conn.close()


def validate_title(title: str) -> None:
    if not (1 <= len(title) <= 120):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail="title must be 1 to 120 characters",
        )


def normalize_and_validate_tags(tags: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    seen = set()
    normalized: List[str] = []

    for tag in tags:
        if not TAG_RE.fullmatch(tag):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail="tag must be 1 to 30 lowercase letters or digits",
            )
        if tag not in seen:
            seen.add(tag)
            normalized.append(tag)

    return normalized


def fetch_tags_for_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> List[str]:
    rows = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT t.name
        FROM tags AS t
        INNER JOIN note_tags AS nt ON nt.tag_id = t.id
        WHERE nt.note_id = ?
        ORDER BY t.name
        """,
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    return [row["name"] for row in rows]


def fetch_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes WHERE id = ?",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchone()

    if row is None:
        return None

    return {
        "id": row["id"],
        "title": row["title"],
        "body": row["body"],
        "created_at": row["created_at"],
        "tags": fetch_tags_for_note(conn, note_id),
    }


def attach_tags(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int, tags: List[str]) -> None:
    for tag in tags:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO tags(name) VALUES (?) ON CONFLICT(name) DO NOTHING",
            (tag,),
        )
        tag_row = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = ?", (tag,)).fetchone()
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO note_tags(note_id, tag_id) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(note_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING",
            (note_id, tag_row["id"]),
        )


@app.post("/notes", response_model=NoteOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_note(payload: NoteCreate, conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_conn)) -> dict:
    validate_title(payload.title)
    tags = normalize_and_validate_tags(payload.tags)
    created_at = utc_now_iso()

    with conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO notes(title, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (payload.title, payload.body, created_at),
        )
        note_id = cur.lastrowid
        attach_tags(conn, note_id, tags)

    note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    return note


@app.get("/notes/{note_id}", response_model=NoteOut)
def get_note(note_id: int, conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_conn)) -> dict:
    note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    if note is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="note not found")
    return note


@app.get("/notes", response_model=List[NoteOut])
def list_notes(
    tag: Optional[str] = Query(default=None),
    conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_conn),
) -> List[dict]:
    if tag is not None and not TAG_RE.fullmatch(tag):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail="tag must be 1 to 30 lowercase letters or digits",
        )

    if tag is None:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC"
        ).fetchall()
    else:
        rows = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT DISTINCT n.id, n.title, n.body, n.created_at
            FROM notes AS n
            INNER JOIN note_tags AS nt ON nt.note_id = n.id
            INNER JOIN tags AS t ON t.id = nt.tag_id
            WHERE t.name = ?
            ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
            """,
            (tag,),
        ).fetchall()

    notes: List[dict] = []
    for row in rows:
        notes.append(
            {
                "id": row["id"],
                "title": row["title"],
                "body": row["body"],
                "created_at": row["created_at"],
                "tags": fetch_tags_for_note(conn, row["id"]),
            }
        )

    return notes


@app.delete("/notes/{note_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_note(note_id: int, conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_conn)) -> Response:
    with conn:
        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,))
        if cur.rowcount == 0:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="note not found")

    return Response(status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
```

import importlib
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture()
def client(monkeypatch):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        db_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "notes_test.db")
        monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", db_path)

        # Ensure app module is imported fresh so it picks up NOTES_DB
        if "app" in sys.modules:
            del sys.modules["app"]
        import app as app_module

        importlib.reload(app_module)
        test_client = TestClient(app_module.app)
        try:
            yield test_client
        finally:
            test_client.close()


def _assert_iso8601_utc(value: str):
    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    assert parsed.tzinfo is not None
    assert parsed.utcoffset() == timezone.utc.utcoffset(parsed)


def test_create_note_with_tags(client):
    payload = {
        "title": "First note",
        "body": "This is a tagged note",
        "tags": ["work", "todo123"],
    }
    response = client.post("/notes", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text

    data = response.json()
    assert isinstance(data["id"], int)
    assert data["title"] == payload["title"]
    assert data["body"] == payload["body"]
    assert set(data["tags"]) == set(payload["tags"])
    _assert_iso8601_utc(data["created_at"])


def test_create_note_without_tags(client):
    payload = {
        "title": "Untagged note",
        "body": "No tags here",
    }
    response = client.post("/notes", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text

    data = response.json()
    assert isinstance(data["id"], int)
    assert data["title"] == payload["title"]
    assert data["body"] == payload["body"]
    assert data["tags"] == []
    _assert_iso8601_utc(data["created_at"])


def test_get_note_by_id(client):
    create_resp = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "Read me", "body": "Body", "tags": ["alpha", "beta"]},
    )
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201, create_resp.text
    created = create_resp.json()

    get_resp = client.get(f"/notes/{created['id']}")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200, get_resp.text
    fetched = get_resp.json()

    assert fetched["id"] == created["id"]
    assert fetched["title"] == "Read me"
    assert fetched["body"] == "Body"
    assert set(fetched["tags"]) == {"alpha", "beta"}
    _assert_iso8601_utc(fetched["created_at"])


def test_list_notes_all_and_by_tag_newest_first(client):
    r1 = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "Oldest", "body": "n1", "tags": ["x"]},
    )
    assert r1.status_code == 201, r1.text
    n1 = r1.json()

    time.sleep(0.01)

    r2 = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "Middle", "body": "n2", "tags": ["x", "y"]},
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 201, r2.text
    n2 = r2.json()

    time.sleep(0.01)

    r3 = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "Newest", "body": "n3", "tags": ["y"]},
    )
    assert r3.status_code == 201, r3.text
    n3 = r3.json()

    all_resp = client.get("/notes")
    assert all_resp.status_code == 200, all_resp.text
    all_notes = all_resp.json()
    assert [note["id"] for note in all_notes] == [n3["id"], n2["id"], n1["id"]]

    x_resp = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "x"})
    assert x_resp.status_code == 200, x_resp.text
    x_notes = x_resp.json()
    assert [note["id"] for note in x_notes] == [n2["id"], n1["id"]]

    y_resp = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "y"})
    assert y_resp.status_code == 200, y_resp.text
    y_notes = y_resp.json()
    assert [note["id"] for note in y_notes] == [n3["id"], n2["id"]]


def test_delete_note_and_then_404(client):
    create_resp = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "To delete", "body": "bye", "tags": ["temp"]},
    )
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201, create_resp.text
    note_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    delete_resp = client.delete(f"/notes/{note_id}")
    assert delete_resp.status_code == 204
    assert delete_resp.text == ""

    get_after_delete = client.get(f"/notes/{note_id}")
    assert get_after_delete.status_code == 404


def test_404_cases(client):
    get_resp = client.get("/notes/999999")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404

    delete_resp = client.delete("/notes/999999")
    assert delete_resp.status_code == 404


def test_422_title_validation(client):
    empty_title_resp = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "", "body": "invalid", "tags": []},
    )
    assert empty_title_resp.status_code == 422
    assert "detail" in empty_title_resp.json()

    too_long_title = "a" * 121
    long_title_resp = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": too_long_title, "body": "invalid", "tags": []},
    )
    assert long_title_resp.status_code == 422
    assert "detail" in long_title_resp.json()


def test_422_tag_validation(client):
    invalid_tag_sets = [
        ["UPPER"],
        ["has-hyphen"],
        ["a" * 31],
    ]

    for tags in invalid_tag_sets:
        resp = client.post(
            "/notes",
            json={"title": "Bad tags", "body": "invalid", "tags": tags},
        )
        assert resp.status_code == 422
        assert "detail" in resp.json()
